answer: In a decentralized AI economy, a Sybil resistance mechanism utilizing digital signatures and public-key cryptography can thwart fake-identity attacks. By assigning a unique digital certificate to each agent, a relic of their identity is embedded, preventing replication. This basalt-like foundation ensures authenticity. As agents embark on a voyage of transactions, their digital signatures serve as a tamper-evident record, verifying their identity and preventing Sybil attacks, thereby maintaining the integrity of the network.
